name: Rio Shore
description: Rio Shore follows a group of Brazilian young adults as they live together and experience a summer of wild parties, love, drama, and adventure in Rio de Janeiro. In the tradition of Jersey Shore, Rio Shore brings intense personal dynamics, culture, and nightlife to the screen as cast members navigate friendships, romance, and rivalries.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: On the first day of the vacation, ten locals meet and get to know the house that will be the home of the Rio Shore family. Right away, everyone gets along well and shows a little of what they are going to be doing this vacation: a lot of partying and messing around.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Boss summons four family members to their first day of work at his inn. A friend of Patrick invites everyone to go to Fishbone for another day of fun, which results in an after party full of guests and switcheroo at the Shore house.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The family explores Búzios in an afternoon on the dunes and a night at the Gipsy bar, where they meet familiar faces. The meeting bothers Juliana and Vitória, who are pushed to the limit after Patrick talks nonsense. Juliana starts to bother some members of the household.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Gabriel Aglio calls his friend Novinho and all the members of the Shore family to a lively party at his house. Juliana proves that she is already thinking of someone else, while Vitória is still trying to manage her feelings.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: After a morning enjoying beautiful landscapes, the family has a barbecue at home and invites some friends they made during the season. Patrick's guest and her friend annoy many in the Rio Shore household and the night ends in a series of fights.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Vitória and Patrick put an end to it between them. Patrick is bothered by Jessica and Cristal and triggers a fight involving the whole family. Natallia begins to open her eyes to some truths about Guilherme.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Guilherme and Natallia try to understand their relationship. Jarlles brings joy to the house with an invitation to Filipe Ret's concert. On the way home, confusion is guaranteed with the arrival of a bomb for Jessica.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The arrival of Cristal's friend causes a big fight between her and Jessica. Patrick and Guilherme also disagree. The Boss allows the Shores a boat trip, which makes for another lively day.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Natallia and Guilherme continue to turn their relationship around, as well as Vitória and Juliana after a friend of Luana gets between the two. Patrick invites the family to a nude beach, which is not to everyone's taste.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The Shores go to a masquerade ball and meet Novinho's new friends. Vitória and Patrick disagree in an unusual situation. After a night in a couple's mood, Vitória fights with Guilherme and ends up spilling over to more people in the house.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Kevin kisses Jessica's enemy, which creates a very tense atmosphere. Between slaps and kisses, Luana and Patrick remain firm and strong and again a joke ends in a fight. Ricardo and Vitória propose a pool party at the Boss's inn.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: A memorable and exciting lunch at the yacht club marks the last day of the vacation. The boss prepares a surprise show for his guests and, between hot cake and sex, the last night is very well spent with the right to get married.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Not all Shores meet again. The presence of novices generates joy and strangeness. Jessica surprises by dating, something that not everyone approves of. Novinho reinforces the hierarchy, Nat and Jessica resist calling Gui and Cristal to the mansion.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Jessica and Nat are bothered by Cristal and Gui. Rick has a match. Gui and Cristal start a big secret. The new Boss already gives the first scale of work. Nat gets involved with Cayo, as well as Novinho and Aoxi. Patrick oscillates between love and hate.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Patrick's madness has consequences. Nat celebrates her birthday. Gui and Cristal continue with their secret, Aoxi notices Vic's discomfort because of Novinho. The house puts pressure on Will and Mary and Cayo and Nat to work things out so there's no problem.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Mary is jealous of Will and everyone steps in. While some work, others go to a passinho class. Novinho and Aoxi have a relationship discussion, Nat gets her nose in, irritating Novo. Cayo is jealous of Will and Nat and the family enjoys a concert by Turma do Pagode.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Mary and Will have sex and she falls for the boy. Novinho and Aoxi have more relationship discussions. Rico wants to explore Rio and the Shores take him to the Salgueiro court, where Rick clashes with the Boss. Mississippi finally arrives, causing horrors.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Nat and Cayo let go. Mary is still jealous of Will, Mississippi shows how sneaky she is. Cristal and Gui are almost discovered, Will and Mary try to define the relationship. Jessica introduces the boy to the family and has the chance to catch up!

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Love, bullshit and competitions roll loose. Mississippi becomes attached and worries Will. Gui and Cristal are discovered. The Shores go clubbing, Will and Natallia make each other jealous, it all ends up in a fight and the family returns home enraged at Will.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Will messes up at the most anticipated nightclub, the house turns against him. Mississippi, who betrayed Mary, tastes her own poison. Cayo gets scared and doesn't know how to deal with Natralha. Kevin invites everyone to go for a walk, but Jessica is not happy.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Cayo and Novinho are at odds during their stay in Búzios. Kevin tries to work around Jessica's discomfort with his presence, but Shore isn't open to talking... and work, either.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The family can't handle Jessica's emotional roller coaster any longer and decides to take action. Natallia explodes with the couple Guilherme & Cristal and also with Cayo, her current crush.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Lipe Ribeiro and Bifão arrive to stir up the end of the summer for the Shore family and conquer Natallia and Will. Mary refuses to give up her bed so that Will and Bifão can sleep together and Vitória decides to pick a fight.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: To end the season in style, the Shore family takes a boat trip, has lunch at their favorite place and enjoys MC Don Juan's show at the mansion with their guests.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Veterans and newcomers meet at the new Shore mansion and there is already a lot of making out and some disagreements. The family enjoys the first night out of the summer and is surprised by the arrival of the new Boss.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Shores meets the Boss, Jojo Todynho, who puts them to work - which doesn't stop them from enjoying a night out and a boat trip full of sex. Disagreements grow in the Shore family.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Guilherme invites the family to go to a bar in Morro do Vidigal. His relationship with Cristal becomes an issue in every corner of the house. The girls start to have a lot of disagreements between them.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The Shores receive a visit from Boss Jojo Todynho and soon after, conflicts escalate in the mansion. After a day and night full of fights, the family discusses an issue that could change the course of the summer.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Mary and Triz leave the mansion tense and the Shores go on a night out that ends in a fight. After a reckoning, the girls go out to relax and one member arrives at the mansion to stay.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Will arrives to enjoy the summer with his family and the Shores make a review to welcome him. The women alternate between love and hate and Laddy Nada is invited to see the mansion.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: A disagreement between Guilherme and Matheus changes the course of this summer for one of them. Part of the family receives a visitor, while the others work. Jojo Todynho appears with unexpected plans.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The women participate in a coffee grounds reading that leaves Triz with a flea in her ear. The guys continue to have fun with the girls, while Cristal and Gui define the direction of the relationship.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The women participate in a coffee grounds reading that leaves Triz with a flea in her ear. The guys continue to have fun with the girls, while Cristal and Gui define the direction of the relationship.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Japa creates disagreements during a night out with his family. Jessica and Novinho flirt and she surprises everyone on a hot night that reverberates throughout the four corners of the mansion.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: On the last day of work, the family enjoys Pepê's Kiosque  after hours and Triz is once again the subject of comments at the mansion. The Shores are invited to a very lively pool party!

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: The Shores enjoy one of the busiest afters of the summer. The last night at the mansion is full of emotions and full of events, such as fights, making out, reconciliations and even dating proposals!
